name: Ribbed Sedge
desc: Ribbed Sedge (Carex virescens): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 2 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Carex virescens, the ribbed sedge, is a species of flowering plant in the family Cyperaceae, native to eastern North America. It strongly resembles and has nearly the same range as Carex swanii.
